# Gboard Material Expressive Black LSPosed module that restores pitch black backgrounds to Gboard on Android 16, bypassing Material 3 Expressive enforcement while preserving dynamic theme colors. ![GitHub Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/hxreborn/gboard-material-expressive-black) ![GitHub Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/hxreborn/gboard-material-expressive-black/total) ![Android API](https://img.shields.io/badge/API-31%2B-brightgreen) ![Kotlin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Kotlin-2.0.0-blue) ![APK Size](https://img.shields.io/badge/APK%20Size-~25KB-orange) ## Why This Module? Starting with Android 16 and Material 3 Expressive, Gboard enforces tinted grey surface colors instead of pitch black. This design change breaks AMOLED power savings and prevents pure black themes. This module intercepts Material You color lookups at the system level using LSPosed hooks, replacing surface container colors with pitch black while preserving wallpaper-derived dynamic theme colors. ## Visual Comparison **Module off** **Module on**
With key borders on **Module off** **Module on**
## Requirements - Android 12+ (Android 16+ recommended for grey background fix) - LSPosed framework Tested on Pixel 9 Pro, Android 16 (BP3A.251105.015), LSPosed, KernelSU Next. Functionality on other configurations untested. ## Installation 1. Install LSPosed with API 101 support 2. Download latest APK from [releases](https://github.com/hxreborn/gboard-material-expressive-black/releases) 3. Install APK and enable module in LSPosed Manager 4. Add **Gboard** to module scope 5. Force stop Gboard 6. Open any text field to trigger Gboard ## Building from source ```bash git clone https://github.com/hxreborn/gboard-material-expressive-black.git cd gboard-material-expressive-black ./gradlew assembleDebug ``` **Build requirements:** JDK 21, Gradle 8.7+ ## License [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT) This project is licensed under the MIT License - see the [LICENSE](https://github.com/hxreborn/gboard-material-expressive-black/blob/main/LICENSE) file for details.
readmeZh: # Gboard 材质表现力黑色 LSPod 模块可在 Android 16 上将漆黑的背景恢复到 Gboard，绕过 Material 3 Expressive 强制，同时保留动态主题颜色。 ![GitHub 发布](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/hxreborn/gboard-material-expressive-black) ![GitHub 下载](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/hxreborn/gboard-material-expressive-black/total) ![Android API](https://img.shields.io/badge/API-31%2B-brightgreen) ![Kotlin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Kotlin-2.0.0-blue) ![APK 大小](https://img.shields.io/badge/APK%20Size-~25KB-orange) ## 为什么选择这个模块？ 从 Android 16 和 Material 3 Expressive 开始，Gboard 强制实施浅灰色表面颜色，而不是纯黑色。这一设计变更打破了 AMOLED 的省电模式，并阻止了纯黑色主题的出现。 该模块使用 LSPosed 挂钩在系统级别拦截 Material You 颜色查找，将表面容器颜色替换为纯黑色，同时保留源自壁纸的动态主题颜色。 ## 视觉比较 **模块关闭** **模块开启** <详情> 带有关键边框 **模块关闭** **模块开启** ## 要求 - Android 12+（建议使用Android 16+修复灰色背景） - LSPod框架 在 Pixel 9 Pro、Android 16 (BP3A.251105.015)、LSPod、KernelSU Next 上进行测试。其他配置的功能未经测试。 ## 安装 1. 安装支持 API 101 的 LSPod 2. 从[releases](https://github.com/hxreborn/gboard-material-expressive-black/releases)下载最新的APK 3. 在 LSPod Manager 中安装 APK 并启用模块 4. 将 **Gboard** 添加到模块范围 5.强制停止Gboard 6.打开任意文本字段即可触发Gboard ## 从源代码构建 ````bash git 克隆 https://github.com/hxreborn/gboard-material-expressive-black.git cd gboard-材质-表现力-黑色 ./gradlew assemble调试 ```` **构建要求：** JDK 21、Gradle 8.7+ ## 许可证 [![许可证：MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT) 该项目已根据 MIT 许可证获得许可 - 有关详细信息，请参阅 [LICENSE](https://github.com/hxreborn/gboard-material-expressive-black/blob/main/LICENSE) 文件。
